name: South Korea
prevalence_note: KNPA Integrated Counter-Scam Center (1394) & FSS 2025-2026: Prosecutor/FSS & fake card-courier impersonation (서울중앙지검·카드 배송원 사칭·안전계좌·원격제어 앱), low-interest refinancing loan fraud (대환대출), broken-screen family impersonation demanding transfers or gift-card PINs, and NTS/NHIS tax or health-insurance refund vishing dominate.
cross_border_note: 070 internet numbers and overseas call-center lines relayed into spoofed local 010 mobile numbers via illegal SIM-box gateways are heavily used in Korean voice phishing.

scams.name: 검찰·금감원·카드배송원 사칭（대포통장·안전계좌·원격제어）
scams.name_en: Fake Seoul prosecutor, FSS or card courier leading to safe-account or remote-app phishing
scams.signals_en: Poses as Seoul Central Prosecutor/FSS or fake credit-card courier ('an unrequested card was issued') routing victim to fake customer service and prosecutors demanding remote apps or safe-account transfers.
scams.legit_en: Real parcel/card delivery simply confirming drop-off address with no fake customer-service phone number, remote app, or prosecutor transfer.
bait_tactics: 깜짝 놀라 협조하려는 척하면서 돋보기를 찾느라 시간이 걸린다며 사건 경위를 천천히 다시 설명해 달라고 하기
스마트폰 조작이 서툰 척하며 화면에 뭐가 떠 있는지 모르겠다고 절차부터 자세히 물어보기
어떤 은행 카드인지 기억이 안 난다며 카드 색깔과 신청 날짜를 천천히 다시 확인해 달라고 하기

scams.name: 저금리 대환대출·정부지원 서민대출 빙자 사기
scams.name_en: Fake government-backed low-interest refinancing loan demanding prior loan payoff
scams.signals_en: Impersonates Korea Inclusive Finance Agency (서민금융진흥원) or a commercial bank offering government-backed low-interest refinancing, then claims an existing loan contract was breached and demands upfront payoff to a personal account, credit-score upgrade fees...
scams.legit_en: Korea Inclusive Finance Agency and legitimate Korean banks never advertise loans via unsolicited calls/SMS or demand upfront fees, deposits, or personal-account repayments.
bait_tactics: 금리가 낮아진다니 관심이 많은 척하며 월 상환액과 중도상환수수료를 하나하나 다시 계산해 달라고 하기
서류를 적어두겠다며 볼펜과 종이를 찾는 척 천천히 심사 조건을 되묻기

scams.name: 지인·자녀 사칭 액정 파손 급전 송금·상품권 핀번호 사기
scams.name_en: Fake child or relative claiming broken phone screen and demanding urgent transfer, gift-card PINs, or remote app
scams.signals_en: Contacts parents via a temporary number or messaging app claiming their phone screen cracked ('액정이 깨져서') and voice calls do not work, then urgently asks the parent to wire money to a third party ('대신 송금'), send convenience-store gift card PINs ('상품권 핀번호')...
scams.legit_en: Real children with a damaged phone can still be verified via their workplace, school, or original number and never ask parents to install remote-control apps or buy gift-card PINs in secret.
bait_tactics: 너무 걱정되는 척하면서 어느 수리센터에 맡겼는지 위치와 수리 기사님 설명을 자세히 물어보기
모바일뱅킹 비밀번호가 기억나지 않는 척하며 집 근처 은행 창구에 직접 걸어가서 확인해 보겠다고 시간 끌기
편의점에 왔는데 상품권 종류가 너무 많아 헷갈린다며 봉투 모양을 계속 천천히 되묻기

scams.name: 국세청·국민건강보험공단 사칭 미환급금·계좌 인증 보이스피싱
scams.name_en: Fake National Tax Service or National Health Insurance unpaid-refund & account-verification scam
scams.signals_en: Impersonates National Tax Service (국세청) tax officers or National Health Insurance Service (국민건강보험공단) staff claiming an unclaimed tax or health-insurance premium refund ('미환급금') is waiting, then demands resident registration numbers...
scams.legit_en: South Korea's National Tax Service (Hometax) and NHIS process refunds through official portals or formal notices without phoning citizens for full resident numbers, card photos, or transfer fees.
bait_tactics: 환급금이 있다니 반가운 척하면서 몇 년도 몇 월분 보험료인지 세부 내역을 천천히 읽어 달라고 하기
홈택스나 건강보험 앱에 직접 들어가서 조회해 보겠다며 로그인 화면이 안 열린다고 기다리게 하기
통장이 장롱 깊숙한 곳에 있어 찾는 데 시간이 걸린다며 관할 지사 위치를 자세히 물어보기
